info.title: Concept2Cure — Global Regulatory Intelligence API
info.description: Deterministic, citation-backed cross-market regulatory-intelligence services. Generated from the capability catalog (GET /api/global-ri/catalog); do not hand-edit. 41 capabilities across 9 groups; 26 AnA tools.

tags.name: strategy
tags.description: Strategy & Pathway — Pathway selection, cross-market strategy brief, dossier legal basis, fees, reliance, and guidance.

tags.name: designations_access
tags.description: Designations & Access — Orphan/pediatric designations, expedited programs, and pre-approval (expanded) access.

tags.name: clinical
tags.description: Clinical & Nonclinical — Trial-application requirements, HA meetings, nonclinical (ICH M3), bioequivalence, and evidence standards.

tags.name: quality_cmc
tags.description: Quality & CMC — Specifications, stability, impurities, and process validation.

tags.name: safety_pv
tags.description: Safety & Pharmacovigilance — Investigational safety reporting, post-approval pharmacovigilance, and GCP records.

tags.name: submissions
tags.description: Submissions & Format — Module 1, electronic submission format, labeling, post-approval changes, and inspection readiness.

tags.name: devices_dx
tags.description: Devices & Diagnostics — Device/IVD classification, combination products, companion diagnostics, and advanced therapies.

tags.name: lifecycle
tags.description: Lifecycle & Post-market — Exclusivity/LOE, recurring lifecycle obligations, and clinical-trial disclosure.

tags.name: commercial_supply
tags.description: Commercial & Supply Chain — Promotion, controlled substances, establishment registration, import/export, and distribution (GDP).
